objective: Continue running the value-routing dispatch workflow (agentops .claude/workflows/vuoro-dispatch-build.js) on real sprint items, and fix what each run exposes, until the pending delivered items close through the gated path and the next batch of agentops-local items flows end to end. Routing and readiness add value rather than gate it: route -> refine (Opus 5.5) / oracle (Opus 5.5, separate author) -> build (Sonnet 5.5) -> independent verify -> up to 2 repairs -> park (git revert) -> publish verified work -> close. The operator is not escalated to by default.
constraints: Nothing waits on the operator by default. Refine and decide from documented direction, recording decisions on the item. Raise to the operator only when product intention is entirely missing, or for the operator's own authority (their credentials, spending, irreversible production changes), with exact steps. Never track or count escalations as a metric.

Planners and refiners keep genuine oversight: router and lattice advice is advisory. Guard against Goodhart: never drop scope, only move it to a named follow-up with a 'build: scope moved' or 'refinement: intent moved' note. The verifier checks each move is justified.
Workflows use claude-sonnet-5-5 and claude-opus-5-5, with Haiku 4.5 clerical only. model-routing.json is canonical; change it via the model-routing-optimizer skill.

Every commit I author gets an independent review posted on its PR before merge. Land on main via PR, then remove worktrees and branches. Changes to .claude/workflows/* and other protected paths need a 'hand-pass:' PR title.
Do not close sprint items by hand. On 2026-09-28 the permission classifier blocked `sprintctl item status --status done` as a CI bypass. Items close only through the workflow's verified close stage.

sprintctl 0.10.0 uses the served backend with advisory reservations: `sprintctl agent-protocol`; `item status --expected-revision`; `--reason` is required for `--status pending`. In a fresh shell, prefix commands with `direnv exec .`, otherwise sprintctl refuses (`SPRINTCTL_BACKEND=local cannot be used`).

The workflow builds in the item's tracker repo only. Items tracked in agentops that change vuoro/sprintctl/appservice code cannot be dispatched yet. Do not dispatch appservice items with push, because pushing appservice main deploys via Flux.
